info.name: Entity consistency (multi-resource)
info.description:
# Entity consistency APIs

Shared cleanup / check / fix endpoints for catalog and people resources (same behavior as Items).

## Auth
- Header: `API-KEY`
- Query/form: `token`, `requester`

## Resources (`{{resource}}`)
`memberships`, `giftchecks`, `vouchers`, `promos`, `vaccines`, `packages`, `lab_tests`, `categories`, `asset_groups`, `account_types`, `nurses`, `doctors`, `data_consents`, `informed_consents`

`assets` is **not** consistency-checked. Asset CRUD is branch-local (no increment-ID sync).

## Suggested order
1. Loop `POST /{{resource}}/cleanup_duplicate_items` until `done`
2. Loop `POST /{{resource}}/fix_consistency` until `done`
3. `GET /{{resource}}/check_consistency` — leftover issues are usually `field_diffs`

## Scope
Master + diagnostic DBs: `mobile`, `oakridge`, `mactan`, `consolacion`, `mantlewood`, `warehouse` (branch 5), `pharmacy` (branch 6). No EMR.

## fix_consistency rules
1. Soft-delete everywhere when master active and any diagnostic deleted
2. Insert diagnostic-only ids onto master + missing DBs
3. Push master ids missing on any diagnostic

Field diffs are **not** auto-fixed.

## Done messages
- `all databases rows is consistent` — active-row check would pass
- `No more supported consistency fixes remaining...` — see `unsupported_field_diff_count`

request.description:
## GET `/{{resource}}/check_consistency`

Compares parent table rows between master and each diagnostic DB.

Reports `missing_on_branch`, `extra_on_branch`, and `field_diffs`.

## POST `/{{resource}}/cleanup_duplicate_items`

Soft-deletes duplicate active rows (entity-specific key groups), keeping `MIN(id)`. Cascades configured child tables. Chunked by `limit` (default 25).

## POST `/{{resource}}/fix_consistency`

### Rules (chunk order)
1. Soft-delete (2.1)
2. Insert from diagnostic (2.2)
3. Push from master (2.3)

Parent row only on insert/push. Field diffs not auto-fixed.

### Done messages
- `all databases rows is consistent` when active check would pass
- otherwise points to `check_consistency` for remaining `field_diffs`

response.name: Done — field diffs remain
response.body:
{
  "fixed_count": 0,
  "soft_deleted": [],
  "inserted": [],
  "pushed": [],
  "remaining_count": 0,
  "done": true,
  "message": "No more supported consistency fixes remaining. Run check_consistency for remaining field_diffs.",
  "unsupported_field_diff_count": 12,
  "remaining_missing_count": 0,
  "remaining_extra_count": 0
}
